# `/build`

> Orchestrated pipeline: implement tasks in parallel waves → review → converge → qa → ship. Use /build quick to skip review and ship.

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-command-docs.py from commands/build.md — do not edit -->

The orchestrator: implements tasks in parallel waves with isolated workers, reviews with independent agents, converges on gaps, runs QA, and hands over to `/ship`.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Usage** | `/build [quick] [--parallel=N] [--sequential] [--isolate=worktree|none] [--max-rounds=N] [feature-name]` |
| **Reads** | `tasks.md`, `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `DESIGN.md` |
| **Writes** | code, `tasks.md` checkboxes, `review.md`, `qa-report.md` |
| **Gates** | Stops on failed/blocked tasks, merge conflicts, out-of-scope edits, base-guard failure, stalled convergence, QA FAIL. Never ships by itself. |
| **Next** | `/ship` |
| **Tools** | `Bash, Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob, Agent` |

  - Convergence loop (`round = 1 … max-rounds`)

- Step 4: Ship (full mode only)
